common.tagline: Continuous accreditation compliance for healthcare facilities

dashboard.title: Readiness dashboard
dashboard.intro: This dashboard will show compliance by chapter and department, essential safety requirement status, overdue action items and the compliance trend over time.
dashboard.emptyBody: Set up your facility, then run a first self-assessment to see results here.
dashboard.setupBody: Steps done: {done} of {total}. Once setup is done, the elements that apply to your facility show up here.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: Check the link or go back to the readiness dashboard.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.accountLocked: Too many failed attempts. The account is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password must be at most 128 characters.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not valid. Check the time on your phone and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

verify.title: Two-step verification
verify.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.intro: Create your account, then set up your organization and first facility.
signUp.introInvited: Create your account to accept the invitation.
signUp.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

mfa.title: Set up two-step verification
mfa.requiredIntro: Your role can change access and approve evidence, so it needs a second step at sign-in. You will need an authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.optionalIntro: Add a second step at sign-in with an authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manualEntry: Can't scan? Enter this key instead:
mfa.saveBackupCodes: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one lets you sign in once if you lose your phone.
mfa.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the app

setup.title: Set up your organization
setup.intro: Name your organization and its first facility. You can add departments and invite your team next.
setup.facilityTypeHint: It decides which frameworks are suggested and which elements apply to your facility.

errors.alreadyMember: You already belong to a facility. Ask its owner to invite you to others.
errors.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.summary: You are invited to join {facility} as {role}.
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in as <bdi>{email}</bdi>. Sign out, then sign in with the invited email.

errors.notFound: This invitation link is not valid.
errors.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.accepted: This invitation has already been used.
errors.wrongEmail: This invitation is for a different email address.
errors.invalid: This invitation link is not valid.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

people.intro: Invite people to this facility and choose what they can do.
people.forbidden: Only the facility owner and the quality manager can manage people.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.noDepartmentsYet: No departments yet. Department heads need one; departments arrive with facility setup.
invite.departmentHint: Department heads see and act on their own department only.

errors.invalid: Check the email and the role.
errors.unknownDepartment: Choose a department of this facility.

invitation.subject: Invitation to join {facility} on Mustamir
invitation.body: {inviter} invited you to join {facility} on Mustamir as {role}.
invitation.ignore: If you were not expecting this email, you can ignore it.

library.intro: The accreditation frameworks available to your facility. Open one to browse it by chapter or department. Essential safety requirements (ESR) are listed first.
library.empty: No framework is available yet. The platform team publishes frameworks once their licence is confirmed.

browse.results: {count, plural, =0 {No elements match these filters.} one {# element} other {# elements}}

esr.title: Essential safety requirements (ESR)
esr.hint: If any ESR element is not met, the facility is not ready for survey, whatever its overall score.

standards.title: Standards library
standards.intro: Import framework editions, check them, and put them live for every facility. Only licensed text may be activated.

upload.title: Import a framework edition
upload.fileHint: CSV, XLSX or JSON in the Mustamir import format (docs/IMPORT_FORMAT.md), up to 5 MB.
upload.csvTitle: Framework details for a CSV file
upload.csvHint: A CSV file holds only the elements, so give the framework details here. XLSX and JSON files carry them in the file, and these fields are ignored.

issues.failed: {count, plural, one {The file has # error.} other {The file has # errors.}} Nothing was saved: fix the file and upload it again.
issues.more: {count, plural, one {and # more problem} other {and # more problems}}

codes.unreadableFile: The file could not be read. Check that it is a valid XLSX workbook.
codes.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
codes.invalidEncoding: The CSV file is not UTF-8. In Excel, save it as “CSV UTF-8”.
codes.invalidJson: The JSON is not valid or does not follow the import format.
codes.csvUnclosedQuote: A quoted value is never closed.
codes.unknownColumn: The column “{column}” is not part of the format and was ignored.
codes.frameworkRowCount: The framework sheet must have exactly one row (it has {value}).
codes.tooManyElements: The file has more than {value} elements.
codes.editionExists: {value} already exists. Give this file a new edition.
codes.invalidCode: “{value}” is not a valid code. Use letters, digits, dots and dashes; framework codes are in capitals.
codes.tooLong: The text is longer than {value} characters.
codes.weightNotPositive: The weight must be more than zero.
codes.valueOutOfRange: The value must be between 0 and 1.
codes.invalidEvidenceType: “{value}” is not a known evidence type.
codes.unknownFacilityType: “{value}” is not a known facility type.
codes.unknownDepartmentType: “{value}” is not a known department type.
codes.invalidRollupConfig: The roll-up configuration is not valid.
codes.titleMissing: Give a title in Arabic or English.
codes.translationMissing: The translation is missing; readers will see the other language.
codes.duplicateCode: The code “{value}” is used more than once.
codes.unknownChapter: There is no chapter with the code “{value}”.
codes.unknownStandard: There is no standard with the code “{value}”.
codes.conflictingDefinition: “{value}” is described differently on an earlier row.
codes.scaleTooSmall: The scoring scale needs at least two levels.
codes.esrLevelNotInScale: The ESR level “{value}” is not in the scoring scale.
codes.esrMissingNotMet: ESR elements must be able to fail: allow a level below 1, such as NM.

editions.empty: No edition has been imported yet. Run pnpm db:seed for the demo framework.

preview.title: Import preview
preview.heading: Preview: {name}
preview.warningsHint: Warnings do not block the import. Check that they are expected.
preview.committed: This import has been turned into a draft edition.

edition.title: Framework edition
edition.licenseHint: Who licensed this text to the platform and on what terms. Required before the edition can go live.
edition.draftHint: Facilities cannot see a draft. Activating it makes it live for every facility and retires the edition that is live now.
edition.activeHint: This edition is live. Retiring it removes it from the library; assessments made against it keep their text.

errors.invalid: Something in the form is not valid.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.notDraft: Only a draft edition can do this.
errors.notActive: Only a live edition can be retired.
errors.licenseRequired: Add a licence note before activating. A live edition must keep one.
errors.importNotPending: This import has already been committed or discarded.

onboarding.title: Facility setup
onboarding.forbidden: The facility owner completes the setup steps. You can see what has been saved on the other pages.

hints.facility: Check the facility's name, type and licence number. The type decides which frameworks are suggested and which elements apply.
hints.frameworks: Choose the accreditation frameworks your facility is assessed against. We pre-selected the ones that fit your facility type; you can change them.
hints.applicability: Elements apply automatically by facility type. If one does not apply to you, record that with a clear justification: a surveyor will ask about it.
hints.departments: Add the facility's departments and the type of each, so every element is linked to the department responsible for it.
hints.people: Invite your team now, or continue and invite them later from the Team page.
hints.survey: When was your facility's last accreditation survey, and when do you expect the next one?

facility.typeHint: Changing the type changes which elements apply; decisions you already recorded stay as they are.

frameworks.forType: Your facility type: {type}. Suggested frameworks are pre-selected.
frameworks.none: No frameworks are published in the library yet. The platform team publishes them once their licence is confirmed; come back to this step then.

applicability.esrRuledOut: ESR elements ruled out: {count}. Make sure the justifications hold up; a surveyor checks these first.
applicability.noFrameworks: Choose at least one framework in the Frameworks step first.
applicability.justificationHint: Give a reason a surveyor can verify, such as "The facility does not provide sedation". At least 10 characters.
applicability.noteHint: Why the facility brings in an element the framework ties to another facility type.
applicability.esrWarning: This is an ESR element. Ruling it out needs a strong, documented justification.
applicability.restore: Go back to the framework's rule

people.summary: Team members now: {members}. Invitations awaiting acceptance: {invitations}.

survey.nextExpectedOn: Expected date of the next survey (optional)
survey.nextHint: Suggested as three years after the last survey. Change it to the date you were given.
survey.notesHint: Do not enter any patient information.

finished.title: Facility setup is complete
finished.body: Setup was completed on {date}. You can change any step at any time.
finished.bodyNoDate: Setup is complete. You can change any step at any time.

errors.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.unknownFramework: One of the chosen frameworks is no longer available. Refresh the page and choose again.
errors.duplicateFramework: You cannot choose two editions of the same framework.
errors.tooShort: The justification is too short. Write at least 10 characters explaining why.
errors.tooLong: The text is too long. The limit is 1000 characters.
errors.unknownElement: This element is not part of your facility's frameworks.
errors.unknownDepartmentType: Choose a department type from the list.
errors.nextBeforeLast: The next survey must come after the last one.
errors.lastInFuture: The last survey cannot be in the future.
errors.lastSurveyRequired: Enter the date of the last survey.
errors.lastSurveyNotExpected: A facility that was never surveyed has no last survey date.

settings.intro: Change your facility's details and what applies to it at any time. Each section is a setup step.
